title: Recommend a Community Exhibit

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words recommending a fictional community exhibit to a friend. Describe two objects, who made or lent them, what visitors can learn, and what still needs to be prepared. Use at least six lesson words and two present perfect sentences.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Organize the message around the place, two objects, their stories, and the visit. Use for or since only when the duration or starting point is clear.

reference: I would like to tell you about a small gallery that my neighbors have prepared. The group has worked on the collection for several months, and the first tour will be on Saturday. One exhibit is a portrait made by a local artist. It shows her grandfather holding a blue scarf, and the note explains why the scarf matters to their family. Another object is a ceramic bowl made from clay. The maker has practiced pottery for five years and wants to share the story behind the bowl. The team has already arranged a guide, but it has not finished every label yet. I think you would enjoy hearing the different stories and seeing how people create something meaningful from ordinary materials.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
